items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: my trumpet player, John Audino said, “Hey Terry, why don’t we play eight instead of number four.”

ctx.x: Would you describe your — do you think of yourself as a bit of a control freak?

No, not at all. I mean you know what’s so wild? I listen to anybody in the band. For example I wrote all these things where I did a show called “Operation: Entertainment.” I had all these things follow me, a singer, a comedian, you know I had all these things I wrote for the band. And while we rehearsed a singer, and then I picked out what number would play them off, and my trumpet player, John Audino said, “Hey Terry, why don’t we play eight instead of number four.” I said, “Why?” He said, “Because eight’s in…
Excellent. When I got to about the middle of the book and I turned the page and I saw the title of the chapter Foggo, I said I know who he’s going to talk about now.
